reports.name: Self-contained JavaScript parses; no external script/style dependencies
Initial position: 12 pieces each, seven legal opening moves, dark squares only
Default rules are authentic capture-chain checkers with mandatory continuation
A completed multi-jump is represented as one legal turn
Promotion ends a jump turn; men cannot move/capture backwards; kings can
King capture chains can return to their origin without losing the piece
300 seeded games: movement, capture, promotion and piece-count invariants
Alpha-beta choices and scores match independent exhaustive minimax
Deadline fallback and coach grades are finite and legal
Serialized worker code runs in an isolated JavaScript context
Game boots with visible 64-square board and authentic standard rules locked on
AI waits at least 1.5 seconds, animates once, then yields; no later repeat
Slow pace waits at least 2.5 seconds before any AI movement
Reproduced double-jump position completes the forced chain as exactly one AI turn
AI capture chain is animated jump by jump but commits once
Rapid repeated human clicks cannot queue another AI turn
Worker fault handling: normal produces one legal reply
Worker fault handling: duplicate produces one legal reply
